'''Kristoff Vestswe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was present on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he was walking past the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] entrance with [[Onyeth Canavar]] at the moment [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] caught up with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
